gaps: Four-bar hardware is not a Jansen walker or wind-start experiment.
Readme and dataset metadata do not supply an output-torque calibration or absolute instrument uncertainty.
Link mass and inertia are not specified by the metadata/readme.
No forward model fit or independent held-out validation has been carried out.

source_facts.materials: aluminum links; paper reports ball bearings at A, B, D
source_facts.paper_model: Three rigid bodies; masses and inertias supplied to Neweul-M2, but numerical values are not reported in the reviewed paper.
source_facts.paper_condition: All paper experiments use a paddle stirrer in honey; the previously inspected Bridge_0 files are empty-load trials.
source_facts.tutorial_scope: Input/output parsing and signal visualization only; no mass/inertia or torque-calibration model.

nominal_manufacturer_specifications.interpretation: Nominal resolution/backlash are not calibrated standard uncertainties; stall-torque ratings are not an experiment-specific current-to-shaft-torque calibration.

not_found_in_reviewed_public_material: Numerical per-link mass, center of mass and inertia, including attached hardware/stirrer contributions.
Experiment-specific current-to-output-shaft-torque calibration and associated uncertainty.
Instrument calibration date, absolute accuracy/standard uncertainty and time-synchronization uncertainty.
Recorded controller/firmware configuration, identified current-loop response, transmission efficiency and reflected motor inertia.
our_inferences_not_source_claims: For an ideal horizontal mechanism with unknown absolute inertia, torque gain and friction, scaling these together preserves angular dynamics; recorded current and angular motion alone generally identify ratios rather than each absolute scale.
Repeated trials can estimate repeatability, but do not supply absolute calibration or remove the overall scale ambiguity.

Using measured current as a model input permits an angular-motion prediction check, not an independent prediction check of that same current. Predicting current from commanded current requires an electrical/controller model.
Coupler positions reconstructed from measured shaft angle and nominal geometry are derived observations, not independently measured foot trajectories.

current_software_gaps_read_only_review.gap: The walker torso always has tx/tz slide joints; no fixed-base option.
Bar mass comes from global line density/minimum mass and capsule inertia; no independent per-link mass/COM/inertia contract.
Existing motor is a prescribed-motion servo; no time-varying current input, torque-gain/electrical-control contract.

candidate_validation_plan.scope: A dedicated fixed-base four-bar adapter using the same MuJoCo backend; no claim of Jansen, walking/contact or wind-start validation.
candidate_validation_plan.conditions: Begin with empty-load data; honey requires additional stirrer/fluid assumptions.
candidate_validation_plan.split: Reserve complete input waveforms and independent repetitions; fit only training data and freeze all parameters/preprocessing before held-out prediction.
candidate_validation_plan.outputs: Actual shaft angle and velocity; current is either an explicitly measured input or a separately modeled output, never both for the same accuracy claim.
candidate_validation_plan.uncertainty: Report repeatability and quantization separately; any quantization-noise distribution or missing-parameter prior must be labelled an assumption.
candidate_validation_plan.readiness: Blocked for traceable absolute physical-parameter validation by missing calibration/parameters and the unimplemented model adapter.
